content:
Hi. I like to leave empty lines within commands to make the proof/code more legible. But when I do that I get this message:

Please, write a comment here or remove this line, but do not place empty lines within commands!

Note: This linter can be disabled with `set_option linter.style.emptyLine false`

I know that I can disable this but I was wondering: why the default is to have this message? For me, it makes sense to put some empty lines to improve readability.
